Named at that value alone: read from Botania r1.10-364's jar in the 1.12.2 E2E copy, values 1 to 4 are its bricks, mossy, cracked and chiseled, all made, and its slabs, stairs and walls are left to the rules.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 1.12.2 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was.
